description: Spring / Spring Boot framework pack: annotations resolved by the Spring container, never by in-repo callers. A member carrying one of these annotations is framework-invoked (KEEP); a class carrying one of keepClassAnnotations is container-managed, so its private members are REVIEW at most, never SAFE. The core stereotypes (Component, Service, Repository, Controller, RestController, Configuration, SpringBootApplication) are also listed in src/parse-java.js FRAMEWORK_CLASS_ANNOTATIONS as a fallback; this pack is the authoritative data list and adds the wider set. JPA / Jackson annotations live in frameworks/jackson-jpa.json, not here.
notes: Route handlers (@GetMapping, @PostMapping, ...) are called by Spring MVC via dispatch; @Scheduled / @EventListener / @Transactional methods run on container events; @Bean factory methods and @Autowired / @Value fields are populated by the container. @ConfigurationProperties classes are bound from external config, so their members are container-managed.
